RESTAURANT - USAGE GUIDE
1. Setup (manager) - Restaurant > Configuration > Restaurants: create the restaurant, rates (service, taxes, delivery) and a warehouse for stock. - Create areas (room, terrace, bar) and tables with their seats. - Mark products as menu items (Restaurant tab): course, preparation station (kitchen/bar), recipe. - Menus: create menus with hours and optional prices (breakfast, lunch, happy hour). - Cash: create the banknote and coin denominations of your currency.
2. Cash session (cashier) - Open your cash session and count the banknotes and coins of the drawer. - Cash payments are only accepted while a session is open. - At closing, count again: the difference and the suspect notes are shown to the manager.
3. Service - Restaurant > Service > Orders: new order, choose type (dine-in, bar tab, takeaway, delivery) and the table. - Add items (give a guest number to split the bill), then click Send: items go to the kitchen or bar screen. - Kitchen/Bar screens: Start, Ready, then waiters click Serve.
4. Payment - Add one or several payments (cash, card, mobile, voucher, account) then click Pay. Stock is consumed from recipes. - Print the bill, the 80 mm ticket or the bill by guest from the Print action.
5. Delivery - Create a delivery order with address and phone, send it, assign a driver, Dispatch, then Delivered or Delivery Failed.
6. Reservations - Book a table with date, time and guests; click Seat on arrival to open the order automatically.
7. Reports - Dashboard shows live activity; Restaurant Sales gives daily sales by product.
